title: Closing a fix proved by an eval takes guesses
what: `relay queue done --test` accepts an eval case (evals/plugin/<case>) or <case>::<grader> as the proof, and its refusal names the forms it accepts.
why: Closing tune-hook-false-trigger took 4 tries (3 refusals that found nothing wrong) because `relay queue done --test` wants a file whose text holds the test name, and an eval case's grader file does not name itself.
failing_case: 23 Oct: `--test evals/plugin/tune-no-change-compare::tune-skill-not-loaded` refused "not in the last commit"; `.../prompt.md::tune-skill-not-loaded` and `.../graders/tune-skill-not-loaded.md::tune-skill-not-loaded` refused "does not hold a test named"; only `.../case.yaml::tune-no-change-compare` passed.
pass_cases: `--test evals/plugin/<case>::<grader>` closes an item when the grader file exists at HEAD; a missing grader is refused with the accepted forms listed.
